_meta.name: Could Cover a $400 Emergency Expense
_meta.source: Federal Reserve Board, Survey of Household Economics and Decisionmaking
_meta.note: Annual SHED, a nationally representative online survey of US adults. Could pay a $400 emergency expense with cash or its cash equivalent, without borrowing or selling something. Named exception to the >=15-year minimum: SHED began in 2013, so this edition has 13 annual points through 2025. The 2020 survey was fielded in November, later than the usual timing, which may affect year-over-year comparability; no direction of bias is assumed.
_meta.method: PDF page 50, heading-verified figure; pdftotext -tsv numeric labels matched to nearest year-axis x-coordinate
_meta.breaks: 2020 survey fielded in November instead of October
